title: Enhanced Multi-Model Machine Learning-Based Dementia Detection Using a Data Enrichment Framework: Leveraging the Blessing of Dimensionality.
summary: A retrospective study found that adding clinically informed features improved differentiation among dementia, heart failure and aortic valve disorder in electronic health records from two hospitals.
ai_technology: Publisher full text checked: Methods identify 26,474 EHRs, ICD-coded groups, enrichment and 10-fold tuning; Results report held-out test and cross-validation performance.
organization: Computer and Communication Engineering for Capacity Building Research Center; Mae Fah Luang University

evidence.tested: The authors used 26,474 records, tuned the classifiers by cross-validation and evaluated them on an internal held-out set.
evidence.unknown: The report did not establish performance at an independent site or in a prospective evaluation.
evidence.ai_role: Methods identify 26,474 EHRs, ICD-coded groups, enrichment and 10-fold tuning; Results report held-out test and cross-validation performance.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
